args.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. One facial expression variant from this SAME-CHARACTER A-style neutral portrait. Clearly ADULT lumi age 22. Preserve EXACT head angle/tilt, face proportions/identity, iris color, hairstyle and all accessories, scar/glasses when present, original costume neckline/shoulder crop, canvas composition, neutral lighting, palette, crisp line art and clear-cel A rendering. Identity: Short spiky blonde hair with electric-blue streaks, sky-blue eyes, athletic adult neck/shoulders, original off-shoulder black/yellow circuit jacket and white sport-top neckline. Change ONLY eyes/eyelids/eyebrows/mouth and natural facial muscles. Target expression WORRIED: Inner brows lift with a small uncertain wry mouth, concerned but spirited blue gaze. Make that emotion distinctly readable at 512x512 while respecting character's restrained or energetic personality. Keep skin matte, tiny symbolic nose and short stylized mouth, no added lip gloss, no realistic nose/skin rendering, no new texture or micro-hair detail. Output clean larger square master for non-generative 512x512 resize.
